newsitem.title: USA: TU restores Comanche Peak 2 to full output.
newsitem.headline: TU restores Comanche Peak 2 to full output.

text.p: Texas Utilities (TU) said it restored its 1,150 megawatt (MW) Comanche Peak 2 nuclear power unit to full output after the reactor tripped off line Friday due to problem with a service air compressor motor.
"It was back at 100 percent power yesterday," said a company spokeswoman on Monday.
The adjoining Comanche Peak 1, also rated at 1,150 MW, was taken off line Oct 5 for refueling and maintenance, and scheduled to resume operation in the third week of November.
The Comanche Peak units in Glen Rose, Tx., produce about 18 percent of the company's electricity deliveries.
Texas Utilities is the operator and sole owner of the Comanche Peak facility.
